# CRAN Submission Guide for `ntlgini`

This R Markdown document automates the pre-submission checks, platform testing, and final submission of `ntlgini` to the **Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN)**.

---

## 1. Prerequisites & Environment Setup

Ensure the required development and submission tools are installed.

```{r install-tools}
req_pkgs <- c("devtools", "rcmdcheck", "urlchecker", "spelling", "rhub", "covr", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
missing_pkgs <- req_pkgs[!req_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}
```

Verify package directory and git repository status:

```{r git-status}
stopifnot(file.exists("DESCRIPTION"))
status <- system("git status --porcelain", intern = TRUE)
if (length(status) > 0) {
  warning("Git working tree is not clean! Commit or stash changes before proceeding.")
  print(status)
} else {
  message("Git working tree is clean. Ready to proceed.")
}
```

---

## 2. Generate Documentation & Run Tests

Rebuild `.Rd` documentation, namespace, and execute the complete test suite.

```{r document-and-test}
# 1. Update roxygen documentation and NAMESPACE
devtools::document()

# 2. Run all unit tests (expect 223/223 passed)
test_results <- devtools::test()
print(test_results)

# 3. (Optional) Inspect code test coverage
cov <- covr::package_coverage()
print(cov)
```

---

## 3. Package Hygiene & Policy Checks

CRAN strictly enforces URL validity, spellings, and file size limits.

### 3.1 URL Check
Checks all URLs across documentation, vignettes, and `README.md`.

```{r url-check}
url_results <- urlchecker::url_check()
print(url_results)
```

### 3.2 Spelling Check
Identifies possible spelling errors across manual pages and metadata.

```{r spell-check}
spelling::spell_check_package()
# If new valid technical words are flagged, you can whitelist them with:
# spelling::update_wordlist()
```

### 3.3 Tarball Build & Size Verification
CRAN strictly requires package tarballs to be under **5.0 MB**.

```{r build-check-size}
tarball <- devtools::build(args = "--compact-vignettes=both")
file_size_mb <- file.info(tarball)$size / (1024^2)
message(sprintf("Built tarball: %s (%.2f MB)", basename(tarball), file_size_mb))

if (file_size_mb >= 5.0) {
  stop("Tarball size exceeds 5.0 MB! Must reduce bundled assets before submission.")
} else {
  message("Tarball size is well within CRAN limits (< 5.0 MB).")
}
```

---

## 4. Local CRAN Check (`R CMD check --as-cran`)

Run full rigorous CRAN checks locally. You must have **0 errors** and **0 warnings**.

```{r local-check}
chk <- rcmdcheck::rcmdcheck(
  args = c("--no-manual", "--as-cran"),
  error_on = "warning"
)
print(chk)
```

---

## 5. Remote Platform Testing (Win-builder & R-hub)

Before submitting, CRAN requires verifying that your package compiles and passes checks cleanly on Windows and various Linux flavors.

### 5.1 Win-builder Checks
Submits your package to CRAN's dedicated Windows testing servers. You will receive an email confirmation and report within ~15 minutes at `med.dhia.hammami@gmail.com`.

```{r win-builder}
# Test on Windows R-devel (CRAN requirement)
devtools::check_win_devel()

# Test on Windows R-release
devtools::check_win_release()

# Test on Windows R-oldrelease (optional)
devtools::check_win_oldrelease()
```

### 5.2 R-hub Checks
Checks across Linux architectures (Ubuntu, Fedora, etc.):

```{r rhub-check}
# Using rhub v2
if (requireNamespace("rhub", quietly = TRUE)) {
  rhub::rhub_check()
}
```

---

## 6. Review `cran-comments.md`

Verify that `cran-comments.md` accurately describes the test results and data handling policies.

```{r review-comments}
comments_path <- "cran-comments.md"
if (file.exists(comments_path)) {
  cat(readLines(comments_path), sep = "\n")
} else {
  stop("cran-comments.md is missing! Create it with devtools::use_cran_comments().")
}
```

---

## 7. Submit to CRAN

Once all local and remote checks have completed with **0 errors and 0 warnings**:

### Option A: Direct Automated Submission (`devtools::submit_cran`)
Directly uploads the tarball and `cran-comments.md` to the CRAN submission queue.

```{r submit-cran}
# Submit to CRAN
devtools::submit_cran()
```

### Option B: Interactive Release Wizard (`devtools::release`)
Walks through a step-by-step interactive confirmation questionnaire before submitting.

```{r release-wizard}
devtools::release()
```

---

## 8. Post-Submission Confirmation

1. **Email Confirmation:** Within a few minutes of submitting, you will receive an automated email from `CRAN-submissions@r-project.org` with the subject:
   `CRAN submission ntlgini 0.1.0`
2. **Action Required:** You **MUST click the verification link** in that email to confirm submission. Unconfirmed packages are automatically purged after 48 hours.
3. **Tracking:** You can monitor incoming submissions on CRAN at:
   https://cran.r-project.org/incoming/
